#6

Build an Outgoing Requests page (Performer + Agent), not just Incoming

High
Page: Homepage + Product  ·  Location: Solution › Performer & Agent tabs › Offers

Today the product only has an Incoming Requests page. Daniel needs to also build an Outgoing Requests page for both Performers and Agents: when they invite someone, they send that person an offer. Make sure sending offers/invites is a first-class flow in the product, not only receiving them.

This is a product/build item (new page + send-offer flow), not just landing-page copy. The landing “Offers” panel should reflect that offers can be both received and sent.

Normal
Page: Homepage  ·  Location: Solution › role tabs (Operator / Performer / Agent / Professional)
Current

Tab label: “Professional”.

Change to

Tab label: “Team and Crew”. Update the tab, any headings, and references throughout.

#8

Team and Crew › Availability must connect to events (auto-surface + assign)

High
Page: Homepage + Product  ·  Location: Solution › Team and Crew tab › Availability

The availability panel here is good, but it needs to work like availability elsewhere in the system: when a team or crew member marks themselves available, the system automatically ties that to events. If a person is available on a date and there is an event on that date, shoWMe tells the operator who owns that team/crew that the person is free, and the operator can click to assign them to the event.

Everything connects to an event: availability is not a standalone calendar, it feeds event staffing. Build item, flag clearly in the product spec.

#9

Ecosystem section: new copy + make the animation a spinnable 3D globe

Normal
Page: Homepage  ·  Location: “Beyond the booking tool → From booking tool to ecosystem”
Current

“The B2B platform is the foundation. It generates the operational and financial data that unlocks the ultimate prize: a data-driven ecosystem across the live events industry.”

Change to

An Ecosystem is formed

shoWMe brings venues, performers, agents, and promoters, around one shared event. When everyone works on the same tool, it stops being a tool and an ecosystem is formed.

That data lowers risk, predicts profitability, engages the right audience, and puts an end to disputes. One agreed record. No conflicting spreadsheets. No blind bets.

Animation: today the orbit only drifts left/right/up/down. Make it a true 3D globe the user can grab and spin a full 360° in any direction, like spinning a planet. Press-and-drag to rotate. (See also mobile #M2: this animation is messy on mobile and needs cleaning up.)

Mobile

All of the fixes above apply to the mobile layout as well. Two mobile-specific items on top:

M1. Ecosystem animation is messy on mobile. The orbit with all the party labels crowds and overlaps at phone width. Find a cleaner treatment for small screens (fewer/rotating labels, tighter orbit, or a simplified layout) so it reads well. Note: this pairs with the desktop 3D-globe change in #9.

M2. Why shoWMe animation (#18) applies here too, make sure the “Make the event the center” animation is responsive on mobile.

Note: pixel-accurate mobile screenshots could not be captured from this review environment. Ran can attach a phone screenshot of the messy mobile ecosystem if a visual reference helps.
